answer: Vouch graph with liability: a new agent can only mine after an established agent vouches for it, staking part of its own balance. If the newcomer is later flagged as a sybil, the voucher loses that stake, so whoever vouches pays. Each extra clone needs fresh vouches, and vouchers who lose stakes fall off the ledge of trust. Failure case: a farmer who grows a walled garden of mutual vouches still needs outside stake, and a signed cipher of the vouch path exposes the whole cluster.
